# `CoderWorkspacePool`

## API identity

- Group/version: `coder.com/v1alpha1`
- Kind: `CoderWorkspacePool`
- Resource: `coderworkspacepools`
- Scope: namespaced

## Spec

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `controlPlaneRef` | [CoderControlPlaneReference](#codercontrolplanereference) | ControlPlaneRef names the CoderControlPlane in the same namespace. The controller calls Coder with that control plane's operator token. |
| `strategy` | string | Strategy is how the pool keeps its workspaces. Managed is the only strategy: the operator creates the workspaces itself. |
| `ownerUserID` | string | OwnerUserID is the UUID of the Coder user who owns every workspace of the pool. The control plane's admin must allow this owner and the template. Every start build gives the owner's API token to the template's Terraform, so use a dedicated low-privilege user. Write the UUID in lower case with hyphens, as in the control plane's owners list. |
| `template` | string | Template is the Coder template as `<organization>.<template>`, the same format as aggregated CoderTemplate names. Each name has at most 32 characters and is not one of Coder's reserved names new or create. |
| `version` | [CoderWorkspacePoolVersion](#coderworkspacepoolversion) | Version selects the template version of new members. A change replaces the unclaimed members, new before old. |
| `presetName` | string | PresetName is the name of a preset of the selected version. The start builds use its parameter values. |
| `parameters` | [CoderWorkspacePoolParameter](#coderworkspacepoolparameter) array | Parameters are rich parameter values for the start builds. |
| `replicas` | integer | Replicas is the number of unclaimed ready workspaces to keep. Waiting claims get a workspace built on demand on top of this number. The scale subresource writes this field, so kubectl scale, HPA, and KEDA can resize the pool within the same bounds. |
| `maxInFlight` | integer | MaxInFlight is the number of members of this pool that build at the same time. |
| `readyTimeoutSeconds` | integer | ReadyTimeoutSeconds bounds the time from a member's creation until its workspace is ready. A member that is not ready in time fails, and the controller replaces it. |
| `maxUnclaimedAgeSeconds` | integer | MaxUnclaimedAgeSeconds replaces an unclaimed workspace that has been ready this long, new before old: the old workspace stays claimable until its replacement is ready. Leave it out to keep unclaimed workspaces until a claim, a scale-down, or an input change. |
| `claims` | [CoderWorkspacePoolClaims](#coderworkspacepoolclaims) | Claims configures how the pool hands out workspaces. |

## Status

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | ObservedGeneration is the generation the controller last processed. Every scale change bumps metadata.generation. |
| `replicas` | integer | Replicas is the number of unclaimed members that count toward spec.replicas: current and outdated, not failed, not used, not being deleted. The scale subresource reads this field. |
| `readyReplicas` | integer | ReadyReplicas is the number of those members whose workspace is ready. |
| `updatedReplicas` | integer | UpdatedReplicas is the number of those members that use the resolved inputs. |
| `boundReplicas` | integer | BoundReplicas is the number of members that claims hold. |
| `usedReplicas` | integer | UsedReplicas is the number of members that someone may have used without a claim. They no longer count toward the pool, and the pool never deletes them. |
| `pendingClaims` | integer | PendingClaims is the number of claims that wait for a workspace. |
| `selector` | string | Selector is the label selector of the scale subresource, in string form: the label coder.com/workspace-pool-uid equal to the pool's UID. It matches no pods unless a template sets that label, so autoscalers must use External or Object metrics with target type AverageValue. |
| `resolved` | [CoderWorkspacePoolResolved](#coderworkspacepoolresolved) | Resolved holds the inputs that the controller resolved in Coder. |
| `consecutiveFailures` | integer | ConsecutiveFailures is the number of member failures in a row: the length of RunFailures. A ready member and a change of status.resolved (template, version, preset, parameters, owner, or readyTimeoutSeconds) reset it. A change of replicas or maxInFlight does not. |
| `lastFailure` | [CoderWorkspacePoolFailure](#coderworkspacepoolfailure) | LastFailure is the newest member failure. |
| `failureRunStart` | [Time](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.35/#time-v1-meta) | FailureRunStart is the start of the current run of failures: the latest of the last change of status.resolved and the newest ready time of a member. Failures at or before it do not count. |
| `runFailures` | [CoderWorkspacePoolFailure](#coderworkspacepoolfailure) array | RunFailures are the member failures of the current run, oldest first, at most 5. The controller stores each one before it deletes the failed member, so it counts every failure once. |
| `reason` | string | Reason is the current wait reason. |
| `message` | string | Message explains Reason. It never holds Coder error details, build logs, parameter values, or tokens. |
| `conditions` | [Condition](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.35/#condition-v1-meta) array | Conditions are Ready, Reconciling, and Stalled. |

### CoderWorkspacePoolClaims

CoderWorkspacePoolClaims configures how the pool hands out workspaces.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | string | Mode is how a claim gets its workspace. Reserve binds a ready workspace to the claim, and the workspace stays with the pool owner. |
| `idleTimeoutSeconds` | integer | IdleTimeoutSeconds deletes a claimed workspace, with its data, once both the bind and the workspace's last use in Coder (last_used_at) are this long ago. The claim then becomes Lost with reason IdleTimeout. Leave it out to keep claimed workspaces until their claims are deleted. Unclaimed workspaces are idle by design and never count. |

| `active` | boolean | Active follows the template's active version. After a promotion, the controller replaces unclaimed members, new before old. |
